usage: parallel-dl [-h] [-a] [-v] [-l] [--no-lossless] [--mp3]
                   [--audio-codec {lossless,native,mp3,flac,opus,wav,aac}]
                   [-Q {best,4k,1440p,1080p,720p,480p}] [--playlist] [--subs]
                   [--no-thumbnail]
                   [--cookies-from-browser COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER]
                   [--sponsorblock] [--ejs-remote] [-c CONNECTIONS]
                   [--engine {aria2,rust}] [-o OUTPUT] [-i INPUT_FILE] [-x]
                   [--checksum CHECKSUM] [--verify] [-f FORMAT] [-q] [--json]
                   [--non-interactive] [-y] [--verbose] [--debug]
                   [--limit-rate LIMIT_RATE] [--anti-throttle [ANTI_THROTTLE]]
                   [--no-anti-throttle]
                   [--anti-throttle-grace ANTI_THROTTLE_GRACE]
                   [--watchdog WATCHDOG] [--no-caffeinate] [--no-net-watch]
                   [--stall-timeout STALL_TIMEOUT] [--require-ac]
                   [--no-require-ac] [--pause-on-low-power] [--mirror MIRRORS]
                   [--when-fast [WHEN_FAST]] [--at START_AT]
                   [--priority PRIORITY] [--all] [--interval INTERVAL]
                   [--duration DURATION] [--http3-probe] [--http3]
                   [--no-http3] [--proxy URL] [--push] [--asset ASSET]
                   [--all-assets] [--select] [--source] [--branch BRANCH]
                   [--install INSTALL_TARGET] [--info INFO_TARGET]
                   [--hash HASH_FILE] [--history]
                   [--history-limit HISTORY_LIMIT] [--search SEARCH]
                   [--type {direct,stream,search,github,huggingface,ipsw,pypi,brew,torrent}]
                   [--success] [--failed] [--clear-history]
                   [--from-history ID] [--clean] [--diagnose] [--doctor]
                   [--sign] [--no-xattr] [--notify] [--from-curl [FROM_CURL]]
                   [--clipboard] [--version] [--host HOST] [--port PORT]
                   [--reload]
                   [targets ...]

High-Performance Parallel Multichannel Downloader Suite [paradl / parallel-dl].

positional arguments:
  targets               Subcommand (install/info/hash/extract/history/clean/co
                        nfig/diagnose/netprobe/bench) or download targets.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -a, --audio           Extract audio track for media streams (default: True).
  -v, --video           Download complete high-res video (1080p/4K) instead of
                        audio.
  -l, --lossless        CoreAudio M4A/ALAC stream packaging (default: True).
  --no-lossless         Disable ALAC mastering, keep standard AAC.
  --mp3                 Shortcut for --audio-codec mp3.
  --audio-codec {lossless,native,mp3,flac,opus,wav,aac}
                        Audio codec/format to export ('native' preserves
                        original stream without re-encoding).
  -Q {best,4k,1440p,1080p,720p,480p}, --quality {best,4k,1440p,1080p,720p,480p}
                        Video quality resolution preset.
  --playlist            Download entire playlist instead of a single media
                        item.
  --subs                Download and embed subtitles into media.
  --no-thumbnail        Do not embed or write thumbnail image.
  --cookies-from-browser COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER
                        Extract cookies from browser for yt-dlp (e.g. safari,
                        chrome, firefox).
  --sponsorblock        Remove SponsorBlock segments via yt-dlp.
  --ejs-remote          Opt-in to fetching remote yt-dlp EJS challenge solver
                        scripts from GitHub (--remote-components ejs:github).
  -c CONNECTIONS, --connections CONNECTIONS
                        Parallel connection streams for aria2c (1-16, maximum
                        allowed: 16, default: 16).
  --engine {aria2,rust}
                        HTTP(S) transfer backend: 'rust' (default, in-process
                        rapids) or 'aria2' (legacy JSON-RPC fallback).
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output destination directory (default: '.').
  -i INPUT_FILE, --input-file INPUT_FILE
                        File containing list of URLs/queries (one per line).
  -x, --extract         Automatically unpack downloaded archives (.zip,
                        .tar.gz, .dmg, etc.).
  --checksum CHECKSUM   Expected cryptographic checksum in format
                        [algo:]<hash> to verify upon completion.
  --verify              Automatically discover and verify companion
                        .sha256/.md5 checksum files.
  -f FORMAT, --format FORMAT
                        Custom yt-dlp format specification.
  -q, --quiet           Quiet mode, suppress banner and progress display.
  --json                Emit structured JSON-lines (JSONL) events to stdout
                        for script and LLM callers.
  --non-interactive     Forbid all interactive prompts regardless of TTY
                        state.
  -y, --yes             Automatic yes to confirmation prompts (e.g. installing
                        unverified release binaries).
  --verbose             Enable verbose informational logging on stderr.
  --debug               Enable debug logging on stderr.
  --limit-rate LIMIT_RATE
                        Maximum download speed limit (e.g. 10MB/s, 80Mbps,
                        500K).
  --anti-throttle [ANTI_THROTTLE]
                        Auto-recycle connections when download speed drops
                        below threshold (default: 4MBps).
  --no-anti-throttle    Disable anti-throttle connection recycling.
  --anti-throttle-grace ANTI_THROTTLE_GRACE
                        Grace period in seconds before checking speed
                        threshold (default: 5).
  --watchdog WATCHDOG   Anti-throttle watchdog version: 'v1', 'v2', or 'off'
                        (or comma-separated list for 'pdl bench', default:
                        v2).
  --no-caffeinate       Disable macOS 'caffeinate -i -w <pid>' idle-sleep
                        assertion during downloads.
  --no-net-watch        Disable macOS network-change watcher (scutil / route /
                        scutil --nwi).
  --stall-timeout STALL_TIMEOUT
                        Seconds without byte progress before triggering a
                        stall connection recycle (0 to disable, default: 30).
  --require-ac          Fail early unless the system is connected to AC power
                        (via 'pmset -g batt').
  --no-require-ac       Disable AC power requirement (e.g. for queued jobs
                        which default to --require-ac).
  --pause-on-low-power  Pause or defer downloads while macOS Low Power Mode is
                        active.
  --mirror MIRRORS      Alternate mirror URL for the download target
                        (repeatable).
  --when-fast [WHEN_FAST]
                        Start or continue large jobs only when a short speed
                        test exceeds threshold (e.g. 5MB/s).
  --at START_AT         Schedule start time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g.
                        02:30).
  --priority PRIORITY   Priority for queued jobs (higher integer runs first,
                        default: 0).
  --all                 Apply queue/resume action to all jobs (e.g. 'pdl
                        resume --all').
  --interval INTERVAL   StartInterval in seconds for 'pdl queue launchd-plist'
                        when --at is not set (default: 900).
  --duration DURATION   Duration in seconds for 'pdl netprobe' or 'pdl bench'
                        (default: 60).
  --http3-probe         Probe optional HTTP/3 support via curl during 'pdl
                        netprobe'.
  --http3               Enable HTTP/3 (QUIC) for aria2c transfers when
                        supported by the server (default: on).
  --no-http3            Disable HTTP/3 (QUIC) for aria2c transfers.
  --proxy URL, --via-proxy URL
                        Proxy URL for aria2c transfers (--all-proxy), e.g.
                        socks5://127.0.0.1:1080 or http://user:pass@host:port.
  --push, --adb         Automatically push completed files to connected
                        Android phone via ADB.
  --asset ASSET         Filter release/HF asset by pattern/extension (e.g.
                        dmg, tar.gz, arm64, *.gguf).
  --all-assets          Download all assets in the release concurrently.
  --select              Interactive table to choose which asset or model file
                        to download (TTY only).
  --source              Force download repo source archive instead of release
                        binary.
  --branch BRANCH       Specify branch when downloading GitHub directory or
                        repository archive.
  --install INSTALL_TARGET
                        Download, verify, extract, and install GitHub release
                        binary into local bin path.
  --info INFO_TARGET    Inspect target metadata without downloading.
  --hash HASH_FILE      Compute cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256,
                        SHA512, BLAKE2b) for a file.
  --history             Display recent download history.
  --history-limit HISTORY_LIMIT
                        Number of history entries to show (default: 15).
  --search SEARCH       Filter history entries by substring match on filename
                        or target.
  --type {direct,stream,search,github,huggingface,ipsw,pypi,brew,torrent}
                        Filter history entries by download type.
  --success             Show only successful history entries.
  --failed              Show only failed history entries.
  --clear-history       Clear the download history log.
  --from-history ID     Re-download a previous history entry by its ID (used
                        with 'pdl resume').
  --clean               Clean orphaned temporary download files (.aria2,
                        .part).
  --diagnose            Print system toolchain diagnostics and installed
                        engines.
  --doctor              Run comprehensive system doctor, toolchain, and macOS
                        security diagnostics.
  --sign                Apply ad-hoc code signature ('codesign --force --sign
                        -') to installed binary during 'pdl install'.
  --no-xattr            Disable writing source URL to
                        com.apple.metadata:kMDItemWhereFroms extended
                        attribute.
  --notify              Display native macOS notifications on download
                        completion, failure, watchdog give-up, and queue
                        summary.
  --from-curl [FROM_CURL]
                        Download from a 'Copy as cURL' command string, file
                        path, or stdin ('-').
  --clipboard           Read 'Copy as cURL' input directly from the macOS
                        clipboard via pbpaste.
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --host HOST           API server bind host (default: 127.0.0.1). Use 0.0.0.0
                        to listen on all interfaces.
  --port PORT           API server bind port (default: 8000).
  --reload              Enable auto-reload for API development (requires
                        watchfiles).

Recipes:
  paradl "Song Title Artist Name" -o ~/Music
  paradl --mp3 "Artist Name Track" -o ~/Music
  paradl --audio-codec native "Artist Name Track" -o ~/Music
  paradl --quality 4k "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..."
  paradl gh:BurntSushi/ripgrep
  paradl install astral-sh/uv
  paradl pip install requests
  paradl brew install wget
  paradl hf:TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF --asset "*Q4_K_M.gguf"
  paradl ipsw:iPhone14,5 -c 16 -o ~/Downloads
  paradl "https://releases.ubuntu.com/24.04/ubuntu-24.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso" -c 16
  paradl netprobe "https://example.com/huge-file.iso"
  paradl bench "https://example.com/huge-file.iso" --watchdog v1,v2,off --duration 60
  paradl info "https://example.com/huge-file.iso"
  paradl hash ./downloaded.tar.gz
  paradl history
